Can motorized shades in Corsicana lower at the same time each afternoon?
Yes. We set the schedule on install day, timed to when the sun reaches the TV wall, and you can override it from the remote.

las-colinas-tx.lead: Condos, townhomes and apartments in Las Colinas come with association rules, a balcony door and bedrooms facing lit streets, and motorized shades can be planned around all three.
las-colinas-tx.p1: Associations often ask for a consistent look from outside, so we check the rules with you before choosing the fabric for the street side. The motor stays hidden in the headrail, and battery motors install without wiring, which keeps the job simple in a condo or apartment.
las-colinas-tx.p2: A balcony door takes a motorized drapery track or roller shade, depending on how often it opens. Bedrooms facing lit streets at night need a darker fabric, and a schedule can close them at dusk.
faqs: Do motorized shades work in a Las Colinas condo or apartment?
Yes. Battery motors install without wiring and recharge with a USB cable at the headrail, so there is no electrical work in the unit.
Can motorized shades in my Las Colinas unit meet association rules?
We review the association's guidelines with you before ordering and choose a street-side fabric color that fits them.

argyle-tx.lead: Front studies in larger Argyle homes often face the street, and a motorized shade on the window behind the desk fixes the backlit look on video calls with one voice command.
argyle-tx.p1: A window behind your chair puts your face in shadow on a call and puts the street in the frame. A motorized shade on that window lowers by voice or remote without leaving the call, and a schedule can close it for the hours the sun is behind you. The motor stays hidden in the headrail.
argyle-tx.p2: Where the study has shutters, a motorized shade can cover any upper glass, and a softer fabric shade suits the side windows. Grouping the office shades lets one command set the whole room for work.
faqs: Which window in an Argyle study should be motorized first?
Usually the one behind your chair on calls, then any glass that puts glare on the screen. We look at the room at the free consultation.
Do motorized shades in an Argyle office need Wi-Fi?
Battery motors run from the remote with or without Wi-Fi. Anything that goes through a hub, such as voice control, picks up again once the network is back.

justin-tx.lead: Main-floor windows in Justin open floor plans are seen all at once, and motorized shades in one color family keep the kitchen, dining and living room looking like a single plan.
justin-tx.p1: Each room in an open plan still needs its own light control, so the fabrics can differ while the color family stays the same. Motorizing the main-floor shades puts them in one group, and each one can also run alone from the remote. The kitchen window is the one most worth a motor.
justin-tx.p2: Bedrooms can go their own way with darker fabrics and their own morning schedule, since nobody sees them from the kitchen. Battery motors install without wiring, which means bedrooms can be added in a later phase after the main floor is done.
faqs: Can motorized shades in a Justin open floor plan use different fabrics?
Yes. Each shade can have its own fabric within one color family, and all of them can still be grouped to one button.
Should the kitchen window in my Justin home be motorized?
It is often the best place for a motor, since reaching across a counter or sink every day is awkward. A wall switch or voice command handles it.

boyd-tx.lead: Weather reaches country homes around Boyd from every side, and motorized cellular shades close a whole side of the house against it with one button.
boyd-tx.p1: Older windows let heat and cold through, and on an open property every wall takes its turn. Cellular shades trap air against the glass in January and July alike. Motorized honeycombs can be grouped by side of the house, closing the north windows against a cold front and the west windows against the afternoon sun.
boyd-tx.p2: Battery motors retrofit without wiring, which suits an older country home. Each shade is built to its own opening after we measure on site.
faqs: Can motorized cellular shades in Boyd close one side of the house at a time?
Yes. Shades can be grouped by room, by floor or by side of the house, each with its own button or schedule.
Are motorized shades a fit for older windows in a Boyd home?
Yes. A cellular shade insulates the glass of an older window, and a battery motor goes in without new wiring or opening walls.

westlake-tx.lead: Large Westlake homes have more shades than anyone keeps up with by hand, so we motorize the house and group the shades by room, side and time of day.
westlake-tx.p1: A whole-house system works when the groups match how the house is used. Shades can be grouped by room, by floor or by side of the house, and each group can have its own button and schedule. Our local team sets up every group on install day and pairs each motor to your remotes, app and voice assistant.
westlake-tx.p2: Woven wood and cellular shades both motorize cleanly, which lets living areas have natural texture while bedrooms get insulation. Schedules that follow the sun lower the east side in the morning and the west side in the afternoon.
faqs: How many shades can be grouped together in a Westlake home?
A whole room or a whole floor can run on one button or schedule, and groups can also follow a side of the house. We plan them with you before install day.
Can I use a voice assistant with motorized shades in Westlake?
Yes. Every motor is paired to your voice assistant on install day, and battery motors keep working from the remote if the Wi-Fi is down.

paradise-tx.lead: Corner rooms in Paradise homes get sun from two directions, so we motorize each wall separately and time one for the morning and the other for the afternoon.
paradise-tx.p1: A shade that suits the morning wall is often wrong for the afternoon wall. On the afternoon side, a tighter solar weave stops more heat and glare, and the morning side can take a lighter fabric. Motorized and grouped by wall, each set closes when its sun arrives, and the two still meet cleanly in the corner because every opening is measured on site.
paradise-tx.p2: Corner bedrooms need both walls dark at night, so the two groups can also share one bedtime button. The remote handles anything the schedule does not, and a darker fabric on both walls keeps the morning sun out until you raise them.
faqs: Can two walls of a Paradise corner room have different motorized schedules?
Yes. Each wall can be grouped separately with its own schedule, and both can also be put on one button for bedtime.
Which solar weave should go on the afternoon wall in my Paradise home?
A tighter weave stops more heat and glare, which usually suits the afternoon side. We bring samples to compare at your windows.
